description: T77W968 as Telit LN960 (AT^CUSTOMER 0 or 2), QMI: not in the kernel table; a field hotplug script binds qmi_wwan by new_id and gives interfaces 2-4 to option (3 ttys, AT ttyUSB2, SMS ttyUSB1); one report saw cdc_mbim instead

bind.source: field hotplug scripts: qmi_wwan new_id, interfaces 2-4 back to option1 (AT ttyUSB2, SMS ttyUSB1); the working notes

hints.at_source: a router vendor's port map for 1bc7:1910/1911: AT ttyUSB2, SMS ttyUSB1; option on 02-04 = ttyUSB0..2. Not seen on our bench yet; ModemManager ignores this modem's ttys (mm_ports control); field 2026-11-03 (a tester's LN960A16, FW T77W968.F1.0.0.5.2.GC.013, 25.12.6 filogic): interface 03 answered ATI, 04 stayed silent to ATI and AT+CGMI (5 s each) after a replug; 03 first since then (the profile's order decides between two equal ports); r141 with 03 chosen: ATI answers, AT+CGMI/CGMM/CGMR stay silent 5 s each, AT#USBCFG? ERROR (the Foxconn firmware, not Telit's AT set)
